notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
easyPrerequisites: There are at least three cards in your library.
description:
Cast Rules of Acquisition by paying {3}{U}{U}, drawing three cards and causing target opponent to gain control of Demonic Pact.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
